prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Scope: warehouse, receiving to outbound load release. Elements: Yard Gate Controller=Velvetrook (records vehicle/carrier/trailer/arrival; validates vs receiving plan; flags unscheduled; directs to door; uses Trailer Seal Exception Note; blocks risky vehicles; recovery: holds vehicles outside boundary, yard controlled access until aisle safe); Inbound Inspection Desk=Cinderbay (checks paperwork/seals; sends Trailer Seal Exception Note; records proceed/rework/hold from advisory); Pallet Dimension Scanner=Moonquarry (produces Oversize Load Advisory; never authorizes rule-violating placement); Inbound Pallet Buffer (staging, not acceptance; closed to receipts if path crosses isolated area); North/South Aisle Stacker Crane (stay in aisle; North=Juniperwake sends Aisle Occupancy Snapshot to WMS, uses Slot Reservation Receipt, checks task state, stops on invalid path, reports faults); East/West Transfer Conveyor (interlocks, one-at-a-time; stopped if threatening boundary); Conveyor Line Controller=Brasshaven (produces Transfer Induction Ticket; stops on unsafe downstream; holds transfers on uncertain exception or feeding isolated area); Autonomous Forklift Fleet=Larkspur (produces Forklift Handoff Confirmation; receives hold for routes near recovery area); Outbound Dispatch Sorter (receives Dispatch Wave Amendment); Outbound Checkweigh Scale (Gross Weight Variance Slip out of tolerance; open until reweigh/documented disposition); Shipping Documentation Desk; Safety Zone Controller, Fire Alarm Panel (Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice; both may always stop/restrict movement); Maintenance Release Terminal=Copperfield (Crane Service Release Card; records outcome, repairs, authorizer). Warehouse Management System=Morrowglass: authoritative; produces Slot Reservation Receipt; sends Dispatch Wave Amendment; applies advisory constraints, blocks incompatible allocation; reconciles locations with sensors before recovery plan. Actors: Warehouse Operations Supervisor (reviews/escalates holds; checks delays vs waves; verifies personnel clear before recovery; releases normal work only after exceptions, maintenance holds, access constraints reconciled); drivers, receiving, yard, maintenance staff, spotter. Requirements: no work without WMS release; unique task ref; damaged/held pallets separated; blocked task records hold reason/last location; mismatch blocks auto-allocation; record scan result/location/time. Maintenance: controlled area; crane unavailable; failed test stays inhibited; pass needs interlock/limit checks, recorded authorization. Recovery mode (position discrepancy/obstruction/alarm): Safety Zone Controller sets aisle

New part:
S195: Normal transfers resume in stages, with the first movements observed for unexpected interference or renewed alarms.
S196: Performance is assessed against transfer throughput, task completion time, equipment availability, and the rate of safely resolved exceptions.
S197: The Warehouse Management System records transaction times and reconciles completed movements against the active shift plan.
S198: At shift start, the Warehouse Operations Supervisor reviews open alarms, equipment status, and the previous shift's unresolved work.
S199: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor confirms that operators understand current speed limits, exclusion boundaries, and stop-work criteria.
S200: Autonomous Forklift Fleet receives the Transfer Induction Ticket and validates its destination against the assigned route.
S201: Fleet availability is measured as the proportion of scheduled operating time during which vehicles are ready for service.
S202: Route performance is reviewed using completed tasks, travel time, and the number of blocked or delayed movements.
S203: Safety checks verify that personnel detection, audible warnings, and emergency stops respond before production movement begins.
S204: Safety Zone Controller applies the Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice by maintaining the specified exclusion boundary until release criteria are met.
S205: The shift check confirms that the active boundary is visible to operators and enforced by the applicable control logic.
S206: Juniperwake verifies aisle clearance before resuming a stored-pallet movement and stops if an obstruction is detected.
S207: Moonquarry checks each pallet profile against configured dimensional limits and flags measurements outside tolerance.
S208: Dimensional exceptions are held for review rather than passed forward on an assumed measurement.
S209: The Outbound Checkweigh Scale is checked with a known reference load at the start of the shift and after maintenance.
S210: East Transfer Conveyor demonstrates a controlled restart by running empty at reduced speed for one complete cycle before accepting a pallet.
S211: The restart record includes the initiating authorization, observed speed, cycle result, and any alarm response.
S212: The Conveyor Line Controller inhibits feed if the restart cycle is incomplete or a protective device changes state.
S213: Maintenance Release Terminal status is checked before equipment is returned to automatic service.
S214: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor compares reported downtime with control-system event records at each shift review.
S215: Any unexplained difference is investigated before the affected performance measure is accepted.
S216: Near misses, protective stops, and repeated process delays are reviewed for corrective action and accountable ownership.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
